Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN the loyalty service creates a pending points transaction, the loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Rationale: Earning rule in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN 24 hours have passed since the purchase, the loyalty service shall post the pending points to the member's balance.
Rationale: Return window before points become usable.

Text: IF the POS reports a return within 24 hours of the purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall reverse the pending points of the original transaction.
Rationale: Points must not survive a returned purchase.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points, the loyalty service shall send the member an SMS with the new balance.
IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.
